**Wire verb `stats meta`**: Pool one effect size per study into a random-effects estimate per feature (DerSimonian-Laird), with heterogeneity, direction agreement and the largest leave-one-out change.

# Wraps

- [`RandomEffectsMeta.Pool`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/0a808fec/mzLib/StatisticalModels/RandomEffectsMeta.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/RandomEffectsMeta.cs` at mzLib `0a808fec`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stdin` (wire `--stdin`) | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | One study per line, tab-separated: feature, estimate, standard\_error. No header. A feature's lines need not be adjacent; features are reported in order of first appearance. The estimate must be finite and the standard error finite and positive. Blank lines are skipped. |
| `confidence` (wire `--confidence`) | `float` | `0.95` | fraction (0 to 1) | `(0, 1)` | Coverage of the reported interval, as a fraction. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `study_count` | `int` | studies | never | Study lines read, over every feature. |
| `feature_count` | `int` | features | never | Distinct features; the table's row count. |
| `confidence` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | never | The coverage used, as a fraction. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Equal to feature\_count. |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | One row per feature. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Three static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `feature` | `string` | — | never | As given on stdin. |
| `studies` | `int` | studies | never | Studies pooled for this feature. |
| `estimate` | `float` | units of the study estimates | never | Random-effects pooled estimate. |
| `standard_error` | `float` | units of the study estimates | never | Standard error of the pooled estimate. |
| `confidence_low` | `float` | units of the study estimates | never | Lower bound of the interval: estimate - z standard\_error. |
| `confidence_high` | `float` | units of the study estimates | never | Upper bound of the interval. |
| `p_value` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | never | Two-sided p-value of the pooled estimate against 0, normal reference. Not adjusted across features. |
| `tau2` | `float` | squared units of the study estimates | never | Between-study variance (DerSimonian-Laird); 0 for one study, and exactly 0 whenever q &lt;= studies - 1. |
| `q` | `float` | chi-square statistic (studies - 1 degrees of freedom) | yes: one study: no heterogeneity to measure | Cochran's Q. |
| `i_squared` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | yes: one study | Share of the variation attributed to heterogeneity, as a fraction in \[0, 1\]. |
| `direction_agree` | `int` | studies | never | Studies whose estimate has the pooled estimate's sign (a 0 estimate counts for neither). |
| `direction_disagree` | `int` | studies | never | Studies with the opposite sign. |
| `leave_one_out_max_delta` | `float` | units of the study estimates | yes: one study | Largest absolute change in the pooled estimate from dropping any one study. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | stdin empty; a line without exactly 3 tab-separated fields; an empty feature name; an estimate that is not a finite number; a standard error that is not finite and positive (mzLib's refusal, reclassified, naming the feature); --confidence not strictly between 0 and 1, or given without a value |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | never expected |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- DerSimonian-Laird with a normal reference: the interval and p-value do not widen for few studies (no Hartung-Knapp adjustment), so treat a pooled estimate from two or three studies with care.
- A feature with one study is reported with tau2 = 0 and q, i\_squared and leave\_one\_out\_max\_delta null.
- Each feature is pooled on its own and p\_value is not adjusted across features; send the p\_value column to stats adjust.
